name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys developed a fascination with motorsport from a young age, spending weekends at local rally events with his father. This early exposure ignited a passion that led him to pursue a degree in motorsport engineering. After graduating, he quickly climbed the ranks at a smaller racing outfit, demonstrating a knack for optimizing car performance and fostering team cohesion. His meticulous approach to data analysis and strategic planning caught the attention of Arrow McLaren, where he now serves as Sporting Director.

Rhys's strength lies in his ability to balance technical expertise with strong interpersonal skills. He believes in empowering his team, encouraging open communication, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Known for his calm demeanor under pressure, Rhys is adept at making critical decisions in the heat of competition, always prioritizing the team's overall objectives. He is driven by a desire to deliver consistent results and establish Arrow McLaren as a dominant force in the sport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Rhys is of average height with a lean build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-written notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
Prefers Earl Grey tea with a slice of lemon.
